Team news

On the team news front, Polzin was hugely disappointed to lose captain Nicolai Remberg last time out, with the midfielder sidelined until the end of the season due to a cruciate ligament tear.

Zakaria El Ouahdi, Albert Grønbæk, Bakery Jatta, Bilal Nadir and Patson Daka also sit on the sidelines, with the entire group set to return in the coming weeks.
